integrity: The analytical proof treats the infinite-count law and large-interval limit; numerical checks corroborate finite cases only. No independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous symmetric telegraph dynamics; velocity-selective absorption, inward boundary launch, no Brownian noise or wall residence. First passage duration is not characterized. Exact results rely on a regular Robin-Dirichlet spectral product and generator boundary conditions. Publication priority remains conditional because Foong and Kanno (1994) full text was unavailable.
title: Compound-Poisson reversal-pair law for a successful telegraph crossing
